overview_description.description: White Shark is a blockchain technology company focused on developing AI-powered Layer 1 blockchain infrastructure and decentralized platforms for enterprises, governments, and SMEs. The company’s platform incorporates features such as smart blocks, side chains, and self-evolving blockchain architecture. White Shark also offers exploring no-code development tools and AI integration for Web3 applications.
